name: Wakaba no Toki Onee-chan e...
original_name: 若葉の季節　お姉ちゃんへ・・・
source:
Twin brothers are going to be separated from their favorite sister Yurina. As a parting wish, she accepts their feelings. Confusion and burst of emotion soon leads to pleasure shared among the three hearts.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
双胞胎兄弟即将与他们最爱的妹妹尤里娜分开。作为临别之愿，她接受了他们的感情。混乱和情绪的爆发很快导致三颗心共享快乐。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-april-2006-tenshitsuki-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
